title: File access built from input (ruby) — review required
description: A ruby file operation builds its path from concatenated or interpolated input: File.read(dir + f). Directory-traversal sequences in the input escape the intended directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms the input is confined or mapped through an allowlist.
remediation: Resolve the path against a base directory with File.expand_path plus prefix check and reject results outside it, or map input through an allowlist of file ids.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated path matches, including trusted ones. Whether the input is attacker-controlled needs human review.
